results.question: How was the site designed?
results.answer: The website’s UI/UX design and front‑end were implemented with AI tools: the first version was built on Lovable, then he moved it to VS Code and continued using Claude Code. Sreehari made the design decisions—choosing the colour palette, layout, typography, removing decorative effects, and presenting his GitHub projects honestly—while the AI tools executed those choices.
